sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 800. Deals physical damage 5 times that penetrates any nullifying or invulnerability effects with a success value of 100. (Star).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Activates Time Slice which reduces the time advantageous effects (buffs, special buffs, and non-removable buffs) are applied to the target by 90 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 170. Prohibits Unison for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Rejection for 40 seconds with a success value of 120.
-Target: all enemies. Changes Cost held to 30. [Demerit]
-Target: all allies excluding yourself. Fills Unison gauge by 30.
-Target: yourself. Applies Phalanx for 150 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; nullifies debuffs; nullifies status ailments; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies special debuffs. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects). Recover 100 Cost and fill your Unison gauge by 30 when this effect is removed).
-Applies Nebulous Eclipse (nullifies constant effect skills, applies Grief (10% chance to increase damage received by 50%), increases Ability Power of damage taken while in Break by 50, and increases Ability Power of damage taken from critical hits by 50) to the enemy Field for 90 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 60000

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies kijin (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction; boosts Ability Power of critical hits by 50; increases attack Ability accuracy by 30%; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking) for 150 seconds.

[The Phantom Thieves of Hearts] Queen or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
